title: Poincaré duality on manifolds
description: Poincaré duality for topological manifolds with coefficients in any commutative ring: local homology and orientations, the canonical orientation of complex manifolds, fundamental classes, cap products and compactly supported cohomology, duality over fields and over self-injective rings such as Z/m, vanishing above the dimension, and the identification of the sheaf cohomology of a manifold with singular cohomology, with supports and with compact supports.

units.title: Cap products and cohomology with compact supports
Sheaf cohomology and singular cohomology on manifolds

prerequisites: Core course D60 Algebraic Topology (Fomberg, Spring 2025: Theorem 1.13, Corollaries 1.14 and 1.17, Theorems 1.21, 1.23, 1.26, Propositions 1.25, 1.29 and 1.35; Roberts: Theorems 13-15, Propositions 24 and 27)

Characteristic classes, Thom classes and Euler classes (DG-CHAR-06): Lemma 1.1, Lemma 2.1, Corollary 2.2 and Section 3 (complete chain-level proofs, including restriction to small cochains); Lemma 5.1 and Theorem 5.2

Derived categories of sheaves: Injective modules and bounded-below derived functors (Lemmas 1.1 and 2.1, Proposition 1.3, Theorem 4.1); Sections with support and the localization triangle (Section 1, Theorem 2.1, Lemma 4.1)
AI Integrated Stacks Project, Cohomology of Sheaves: cohomology of a quasi-compact subset as a colimit over neighbourhoods
